digest.component_or_area: build system / lint target / comment-hygiene gate
propositions: The comment-hygiene gate is wired into CI as a standalone step but is not reachable locally via `make lint`, causing divergence between local and CI verdicts.

The introducing ticket for the comment-hygiene gate shows no deliberate intent to exclude it from `make lint`; the gate follows the scripts/check_*.py convention but was never discussed relative to the local lint target.
The measured runtime cost of adding the gate to `make lint` is ~4.9s standalone, with total lint time increasing from 17.8s to ~22.7s, acceptable relative to the 15-minute CI cycle cost of misses.
A wiring test must be added to assert that the `lint` target invokes `python scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`, with a teeth case proving the assertion fails when the invocation is removed.
